faq.title: First Person Boxing FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers from the official Roblox listing, checked 15 October 2026.

items.question: What is First Person Boxing?
items.answer: It is a Roblox boxing experience by Can You Box? with a first-person view, player fights, AI practice, different guards, slips, counters and stamina management.

items.question: Does it support mobile and console?
items.answer: The official description lists PC, Mobile and Console. This does not confirm every device or controller model; check whether the official Roblox listing lets you join on your device.

items.question: Can I practice against AI?
items.answer: Yes. The developer explicitly lists AI practice as well as fighting other players. We have not verified the current menu path or difficulty settings.

items.question: Are there working codes?
items.answer: No working code has been verified by this site as of 15 October 2026. The reviewed official description does not document a redemption system; that alone does not prove no system exists.

items.question: Where is the exact controls table?
items.answer: Specific keyboard bindings and touch-button positions are still being verified. We will publish a controls reference when there is reliable game-specific evidence.

closingCta.title: Take it one round at a time.
closingCta.description: Use AI practice to learn a single mechanic, then bring it into your next player match.
